{{Nihongo|Cody|ゴルディ|Gorudi|Goldy}}''' '''is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].''

Working as a sculptor, Cody is the valley's local artist. His house is located south-west of the Turtle Pond, but he will often wander around the valley. He enjoys going to think and to look for inspiration at the spring and the beach.

He has many sculptures and pieces of art at his home, and is always looking for inspiration to create more works of art. He enjoys nature and beautiful things, like flowers. It will be hard to warm up to Cody, as he is quiet and prefers to keep to himself.

Cody lives in the valley from the beginning of the game.
